# Simple Stanza Window Model

Let's start be replicating the usual stanza window model example that is shown
in rENA.  The configuration is something like this:

```
  |-------------|---------------------------------|-------------|
  | Data        | RS.data                         | chat data   |
  |-------------|---------------------------------|-------------|
  | Units       | Condition                       | Individuals |
  |             | UserName                        |  by site    |
  |-------------|---------------------------------|-------------|
  | Conversation| Condition                       | Chats within|
  |             | GroupName                       |  groups     |
  |-------------|---------------------------------|-------------|
  | Codes       | Data                            |             |
  |             | Technical.Constraints           |             |
  |             | Performance.Parameters          |             |
  |             | Client.and.Consultant.Requests  |             |
  |             | Design.Reasoning                |             |
  |             | Collaboration                   |             |
  |-------------|---------------------------------|-------------|
```

```{r setup, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tma)
library(rENA)
library(magrittr)
```
  
If you're unfamiliar with the standard accumulation using rENA, please 
reference the [Getting Start vignette](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rENA/vignettes/getting-started.html),
but here is a an exmaple model as shown there.

```{r echo=TRUE}
data(RS.data, package = "rENA");
rs_units <- c("Condition","UserName");
rs_conversations <- c("Condition","GroupName");
rs_codes <- c(
  'Data','Technical.Constraints','Performance.Parameters',
  'Client.and.Consultant.Requests','Design.Reasoning','Collaboration'
);
rs_window_size = 4;

model <- rENA::ena(
  data = RS.data,
  units = rs_units,
  conversation = rs_conversations,
  codes = rs_codes,
  window.size.back = rs_window_size,
  weight.by = "product"
)

# print(model$plots[[1]])
```
  
# Same model using TMA

```{r}
RS.data$Context <- "Public"
RS.data$ID <- seq(nrow(RS.data))
rs_set <- RS.data %>% 
  units(rs_units) %>%
  contexts(
    hoo_rules = rules(
      (GroupName %in% UNIT$GroupName) & (Condition == UNIT$Condition)
    ),
    split_rules = ActivityNumber
  ) %>%
  accumulate_units(
    codes = rs_codes,
    time.column = "ID",
    mode.column = "Context",
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = list(
      Public = step_function(rs_window_size)
    )
  ) %>%
  ena.make.set()


# rs_plot <- plot(rs_set) %>% add_network()
```
